headline: Japan Shifting to Wage-Driven Inflation Phase, Finance Minister Says
summary: Japan's finance minister stated the country is shifting to a wage-driven inflation phase following the central bank's rate hike to 1.25% in September.
why: Japan's transition away from decades of deflation toward sustained wage growth and inflation dictates the Bank of Japan's monetary policy path.

impacts.name: Japanese Equities
impacts.why: A shift toward wage-driven inflation supports normalisation of domestic interest rates.

why_moved: Confirmation of systemic wage growth reinforces expectations of further monetary policy adjustments by the central bank.
